cues.show: You, no guitar, the game on screen before Start.
cues.say: This game trains your ears. You need no instrument and no microphone: you listen, and you name what you heard.

cues.show: Point at the tags and the answer buttons.
cues.say: The tags at the top say what it will play: two notes going up, going down or together, or chords.

cues.show: Point at the tags and the answer buttons.
cues.say: The buttons under it are the answers.

cues.show: Press Start. Sing the two notes back, press Replay, then pick an answer.
cues.say: Press Start below to hear the first one.

cues.show: Press Start. Sing the two notes back, press Replay, then pick an answer.
cues.say: Before you answer, sing back what you heard. Press Replay to hear it again as often as you like. Then press your answer.

cues.show: Get one wrong. Press the right answer and the wrong one to compare.
cues.say: After you answer, the game names what it was. Now every answer button plays its own sound: press the right one, then the one you picked, and hear how they differ.

cues.show: Press Next for a few more, through to Next stage.
cues.say: Press Next for another one. The questions come in short stages, and Skip leaves one you can't get.

cues.show: Press Next for a few more, through to Next stage.
cues.say: The goal of this practice is to know the answer before you look at the buttons.

cues.show: Play two of the answers on the guitar or sing them. Name a leap in a tune you know.
cues.say: Try things with it. Guess first with your eyes closed, then look.

cues.show: Play two of the answers on the guitar or sing them. Name a leap in a tune you know.
cues.say: Sing each answer up from one note, so your voice learns the distance too.

cues.show: Play two of the answers on the guitar or sing them. Name a leap in a tune you know.
cues.say: Find a tune you know that starts with each sound, and use it to remember.

cues.show: Play two of the answers on the guitar or sing them. Name a leap in a tune you know.
cues.say: If you play, find the same two notes on your guitar after each question.
